title: Consumer Protection Act
verified_how: fetched Alberta King's Printer Laws Online catalogue entry (ISBN 9780779862993): title 'Consumer Protection Act', Chapter/Regulation 'R.S.A. 2000, c. C-26.3', Status 'Office Consolidation', Current to 7/14/2026; the Laws Online index header states 'Acts current to 2026-08-31'
notes: Alberta's general consumer statute, formerly the Fair Trading Act: unfair practices, cancellation rights, cost-of-credit disclosure, high-cost credit, payday loans, ticket sales and licensing of consumer businesses. Residential tenancy is a separate statute, the Residential Tenancies Act, S.A. 2004, c. R-17.1 (catalogue ISBN 9780779862757, Office Consolidation, current to 5/14/2026). The ISBN used here is the consolidation currently available; a second catalogue entry for the same Act (ISBN 9780779864355, current to 9/1/2026) is marked 'Coming Soon / New Product'.
